observations: Pallets have visible stamps/labels reading “EPAL” on the boards (photo 1 and photo 2).
Some pallets show wear/soiling; one pallet in photo 0 looks slightly misaligned but still intact.
No clear pallet dimensions, model, or count of units is shown in a way that can be verified from the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show wooden pallets stacked and suitable for stacking/handling goods.

claims.claim: Available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No location details are visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Condition/repair status (cracks, broken slats, missing boards) affecting usability and safety.
risks.proof: A close-up video of 1 pallet showing all 4 sides and the underside (fork entry points) plus a photo of any damaged boards.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used pallets with possible wear (not guaranteed as fully intact/ready for immediate heavy-duty use).

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch (seller may be selling a bundle count different from what buyer expects).
risks.proof: A photo showing the exact number of pallets (e.g., pallets counted in rows) or a short clip panning across the full stack with a visible count.
risks.if_unproven: Priced per pallet at the worst-case assumption that the buyer receives fewer usable units than expected.

risks.risk: EPAL authenticity/grade (stamps visible, but could be re-stamped or mixed quality).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the EPAL stamp area and any identification markings/serials on multiple pallets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used wooden pallets despite EPAL-looking stamps.

risks.risk: Moisture/infestation risk (wood pallets can have dampness or pests not visible in these photos).
risks.proof: Photo of pallet surfaces for damp staining + a close-up of corners/underside; ideally a quick smell/inspection note from seller.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed dry/clean (worst-case for immediate use).

proof_requests: How many pallets exactly are included (count) and are they all the same size/condition?
Send close-up photos of EPAL stamps/markings on at least 3 different pallets (including one from the top and one from the bottom).
Send a short video showing one pallet fully (top, bottom, and all sides) including fork entry points.
Confirm whether pallets are heat-treated (HT) or any treatment marking, and whether they are dry/clean (no dampness).
response.reason: The photos confirm wooden pallets with EPAL stamps, but the key pricing drivers—exact quantity and condition (intact vs damaged/usable)—aren’t verifiable from the images alone.
